thread:
maya: FYI onboarding magnet-16b-int8: reproduction for long prefill failure. Prefill ~12k then streaming handoff produced repetition and token dropout near token 11871.

raj: please paste repro command.

maya: python run_infer.py --model magnet-16b-int8 --prefill 12000 --prompt-file tests/longprefill/anchor.txt --streaming True --kv-mode warmstart

olivia: logs?

maya: key snippet:
[14:32:01] prefill wrote 12000 tokens to kv cache (shard0)
[14:32:01] kv_handshake warmstart ok seq=12000
[14:32:02] generate step=11870 token=...
[14:32:02] generate step=11871 token=<REPEAT>
[14:32:02] kv_lookup missed index 11871 -> fallback
[14:32:02] generate step=11872 token=<DROPPED>

tom: crossed shard boundary?

maya: yes (shard_size=16384) crossed shard0->shard1.

raj: does int16 reproduce?

maya: int16 clean. int8 shows issue. rope-scale tweak 0.999 helped but didn't eliminate.

olivia: suspect per-channel quant scales mismatch during handshake. Are per-channel scales sent?

maya: no, we only send compact global summary; per-channel arrays recomputed locally.

raj: that can cause tiny dequant diffs. RoPE magnifies into token diffs. copy mode avoids handshake?

maya: kv-mode=copy -> no issue. warmstart -> fail.

tom: quick fixes?
maya: hotfix: if prefill crosses shard boundary and quant.per_channel true -> force kv-mode=copy and emit alert. Longer-term: include per-channel scales in handshake.

raj: add regression test for cross-shard warmstart ensuring dequantized keys match bitwise. Also add eval vs int16 baseline.
